source.snippet: HN comment on Postgres 14 monitoring improvements: 'I use it frequently - but I wish there was a tool which went into the semantics somewhat.' — expressing desire for deeper semantic query analysis beyond surface-level performance metrics.

problem_statement: Database engineers and backend developers using PostgreSQL lack a tool that goes beyond query timing to explain the semantic meaning and logical intent of complex queries, making optimization and debugging slower.
target_segment: Backend engineers and DBAs at software companies running PostgreSQL in production
notes: Commenter says 'I use it frequently' — active user of Postgres monitoring tools, implying existing paid tool usage. Desire for semantic layer is a recurring theme in DB tooling discussions. Single data point but from an active practitioner.
